wins_analysis: No wins today — zero executions as both pending orders failed to reach their entry levels. The market dropped sharply (-1.7%) but ITC's SELL entry at 273.22 was never triggered, suggesting the supply zone was set too tight or price gapped below it without touching.
losses_analysis: No losses either, but the real failure is zero execution for the 8th consecutive reporting period. ITC SELL had correct directional alignment with the trending_down regime but the entry was too precise/narrow — in a -1.7% Nifty day, ITC likely opened gap-down past the 273.22 entry. ONGC BUY was correctly flagged as 0% probability but was still placed as a pending order, wasting a slot.
regime_impact: Strong trending_down regime should have produced profitable SELL trades but hurt us because entry levels were not adjusted for gap-down opens. The strategy type (supply zone SELL) was correct but entry mechanics failed to account for momentum-driven gap openings in strong downtrends.

improvements.action: When regime is trending_down with Nifty < -1.0%, use market-on-open SELL orders (or limit orders 0.3% ABOVE previous close supply zone) instead of limit orders below the zone, to capture gap-down momentum
improvements.reason: ITC SELL at 273.22 likely never triggered because price gapped below in a -1.7% market day — this pattern has repeated across 7+ weeks of zero fills

improvements.reason: ONGC BUY was placed despite 0% AI probability and being counter-trend in a strong downtrend — this wastes capital allocation and order slots
